description: Fetch a normalized statement as the latest SEC filing reports it, optionally with each filing's version of it. Each statement carries its figures as values and units, one entry per metric code; detail=true adds its facts, per-metric provenance and quality block.

detail.description: When false (default), each statement carries its figures as values and units, one entry per metric code. When true, each statement also carries its facts, per-metric provenance and quality block.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year for the statement identity.

include_version_history.description: Whether to include the statement as each SEC filing reported it, one entry per filing in acceptance order.

statement_date.description: End date of the statement's period (YYYY-MM-DD). Narrows the result to one period when the identity reports two: a fiscal year split at a business combination or fresh-start reorganization is reported as two OTHER periods, both listed in the statement's periods without it.

name: statements_normalized
title: Get a normalized financial statement
